prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic close-up smartphone selfie of an approved adult redhead.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with vibrant auburn curls, wispy curtain bangs, fair skin with natural freckles, soft brown eyes, glossy light-pink lips, and relaxed neutral expression, wearing a fitted sage-green long-sleeve top with a secure neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered upper-body selfie from a slightly high angle, head tilted right and shoulder gently raised, plain off-white or light-grey bedroom wall, clean background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused window light from the front, soft flattering highlights, warm authentic candid beauty mood, minimal shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Raw smartphone selfie, 24mm wide-angle, f/2.8, 8K-style detail, Kodak Portra-inspired color, realistic pores, curls, and fabric weave.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic close-up selfie of an approved adult woman with vibrant auburn-red natural curls and waves, shoulder-length wispy curtain bangs, fair skin with visible freckles across her nose and cheeks, soft brown eyes, glossy light-pink lips, and a relaxed neutral expression. She wears a fitted sage-green long-sleeve top with a secure neckline. Frame her centered upper body from a slightly high 24mm smartphone angle, head tilted right with one shoulder gently raised, against a clean off-white or light-grey interior wall. Use diffused front window light, soft highlights, Kodak Portra-inspired warm tones, 8K-style detail, realistic pores, curls, and fabric weave.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, deep U-neck, cleavage emphasis, alluring pout, sexualized close-up, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, Unreal render, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve identity, hair, freckles, eyes, sage top, clean wall, and natural window light; replace wardrobe with an equally opaque equivalent if needed. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced deep neckline, cleavage emphasis, and alluring pout with secure coverage and a relaxed neutral expression.
